from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shlex
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path('/workspace/android-studio-parallel-sync-policy')
ARTIFACTS = Path('/workspace/android-studio-artifacts/parallel-sync-integration/runtime')
SOURCE = '4fb7a80eacc598a786b4b98c809d1df24a1b02ee'
PATHS = ['.', ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/*.md',
         ':(exclude)docs/android-studio/reference-manifest.json',
         ':(exclude)docs/android-studio/test-parity.json',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/ports/*.json',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/evidence/**/*.log',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/evidence/**/*.json']

def sha(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT)

def snapshot():
    assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == SOURCE
    for cached in [False, True]:
        command = ['git', 'diff', '--quiet'] + (['--cached'] if cached else [])
        subprocess.run(command + [SOURCE, '--', *PATHS], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    assert not git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '--', *PATHS)
    paths = [p.decode() for p in git('ls-files', '-z', '--', *PATHS).split(b'\0') if p]
    bindings = {p: sha(ROOT / p) for p in paths if (ROOT / p).is_file()}
    assert len(bindings) == 4730, len(bindings)
    expected = json.loads((ARTIFACTS / 'whole-source-static-guard.json').read_text())
    assert bindings == expected['files']
    return {'source_commit': SOURCE, 'tree': git('rev-parse', SOURCE + '^{tree}').decode().strip(),
            'fixed_source_pathspec': PATHS, 'files': bindings,
            'index_hex': git('ls-files', '--stage', '-z').hex(),
            'status_hex': git('status', '--porcelain=v1', '-z').hex()}

def touch_roots(label):
    paths = [ROOT / 'crates/android_tools/src/android_tools.rs']
    paths += sorted((ROOT / 'crates/android_tools/tests').glob('*.rs'))
    records = []
    for path in paths:
        digest = sha(path)
        before = path.stat().st_mtime_ns
        os.utime(path, None)
        assert sha(path) == digest
        records.append({'path': str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), 'sha256': digest,
                        'before_mtime_ns': before, 'after_mtime_ns': path.stat().st_mtime_ns})
    (ARTIFACTS / (label + '-source-freshness.json')).write_text(json.dumps({
        'source_commit': SOURCE, 'roots': records, 'source_bytes_unchanged': True,
        'reason': 'Prevent falsely fresh compiler results from shared relative dependency paths.'
    }, indent=2) + '\n')

def compiler_artifacts(raw):
    records = []
    for line in raw.splitlines():
        if not line.startswith('{'):
            continue
        item = json.loads(line)
        if item.get('reason') != 'compiler-artifact':
            continue
        if not item.get('package_id', '').split('#')[0].endswith('android_tools'):
            continue
        assert item['target']['src_path'].startswith(str(ROOT) + '/')
        record = {key: item.get(key) for key in ['fresh', 'executable', 'filenames', 'target', 'profile']}
        record['file_bindings'] = []
        for filename in item['filenames']:
            path = Path(filename)
            if path.is_file():
                record['file_bindings'].append({'path': filename, 'bytes': path.stat().st_size,
                                                'sha256': sha(path)})
        records.append(record)
    return records

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('stage', choices=['all-features-tests', 'library-build', 'strict-clippy', 'format-check'])
parser.add_argument('--lease-granted', required=True,
                    help='Root message identifier or explicit lease authorization record')
args = parser.parse_args()
commands = {
    'all-features-tests': ['cargo', 'test', '--locked', '-p', 'android_tools', '--all-features',
                          '--message-format=json'],
    'library-build': ['cargo', 'build', '--locked', '-p', 'android_tools', '--all-features',
                      '--message-format=json'],
    'strict-clippy': ['./script/clippy', '--locked', '-p', 'android_tools'],
    'format-check': ['cargo', 'fmt', '--all', '--', '--check'],
    'exact-original': ['cargo', 'test', '--locked', '--manifest-path', str(ROOT / 'Cargo.toml'),
                       '-p', 'android_tools', '--test', 'parallel_sync',
                       'check_supports_parallel_sync', '--message-format=json', '--',
                       '--exact', '--show-output'],
}
before = snapshot()
before_path = ARTIFACTS / (args.stage + '-source-before.json')
assert not before_path.exists(), 'Never overwrite an earlier attempt.'
before_path.write_text(json.dumps(before, indent=2) + '\n')
if args.stage in ['all-features-tests', 'library-build', 'exact-original']:
    touch_roots(args.stage)
    assert snapshot() == before
command = commands[args.stage]
started = time.monotonic()
log = ARTIFACTS / (args.stage + '.log')
with log.open('xb') as output:
    run = subprocess.run(['bash', '-lc', 'source /workspace/cloud-environment/env.sh\n' + shlex.join(command)],
                         cwd=ROOT, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
after = snapshot()
receipt = {'source_commit': SOURCE, 'stage': args.stage, 'lease_granted': args.lease_granted,
           'command': command, 'exit_code': run.returncode,
           'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - started, 'log': str(log), 'log_sha256': sha(log),
           'whole_source_bindings': len(after['files']), 'source_index_status_unchanged': after == before}
(ARTIFACTS / (args.stage + '-exit.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
(ARTIFACTS / (args.stage + '-source-after.json')).write_text(json.dumps(after, indent=2) + '\n')
assert after == before, 'Source, index or Git status changed during execution.'
assert run.returncode == 0, receipt
if args.stage in ['all-features-tests', 'exact-original']:
    raw = log.read_text()
    groups = [tuple(map(int, item)) for item in re.findall(
        r'^test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out;',
        raw, re.M)]
    artifacts = compiler_artifacts(raw)
    if args.stage == 'all-features-tests':
        assert len(groups) == 9 and sum(item[0] for item in groups) == 261, groups
        assert all(item[1:] == (0, 0, 0, 0) for item in groups), groups
        test_artifacts = [item for item in artifacts if item['executable'] and item['profile']['test']]
        assert len(test_artifacts) == 9, test_artifacts
        assert all(not item['fresh'] for item in test_artifacts), test_artifacts
        selected = next(item for item in test_artifacts if item['target']['name'] == 'parallel_sync')
        original = Path(selected['executable'])
        frozen = Path('/tmp/parallel-sync-integration-verified-binaries/parallel-sync-tests10')
        frozen.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        assert not frozen.exists()
        try:
            os.link(original, frozen)
        except OSError:
            import shutil
            shutil.copy2(original, frozen)
        assert sha(frozen) == sha(original)
        receipt['frozen_policy_executable'] = {'path': str(frozen), 'bytes': frozen.stat().st_size,
                                                'sha256': sha(frozen), 'source_artifact': selected}
        receipt.update(passed=261, failed=0, ignored=0, filtered=0)
    else:
        assert groups == [(1, 0, 0, 0, 9)], groups
        selected = [item for item in artifacts if item['executable'] and item['target']['name'] == 'parallel_sync']
        assert len(selected) == 1 and not selected[0]['fresh'], selected
        receipt.update(passed=1, failed=0, ignored=0, filtered=9,
                       original_method='checkSupportsParallelSync', original_assertions=9,
                       canonical_parity_credit=0, lead_exact_capture='pending')
    receipt.update(groups=groups, compiler_artifacts=artifacts)
elif args.stage == 'library-build':
    artifacts = compiler_artifacts(log.read_text())
    assert any(item['target']['src_path'] == str(ROOT / 'crates/android_tools/src/android_tools.rs')
               and item['target']['kind'] == ['lib'] and not item['fresh'] for item in artifacts), artifacts
    receipt['compiler_artifacts'] = artifacts
(ARTIFACTS / (args.stage + '-verified.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt if args.stage in ['strict-clippy', 'format-check'] else {
    key: value for key, value in receipt.items() if key not in ['compiler_artifacts', 'frozen_policy_executable']
}, indent=2), flush=True)
